create_ScalarBias_class: create a custom torch.autograd.Function class that prepends a scalar bias value to an input tensor along a specified dimension
build_scalar_bias_function: build a scalar_bias function that wraps ScalarBias.apply to prepend a bias scalar to a tensor along a given dimension
test_ScalarBias_forward: test the ScalarBias forward method to verify it prepends a bias_init value and shifts input elements along the specified dimension
test_ScalarBias_backward: test the ScalarBias backward method to verify it strips the bias gradient and returns the original input gradient shape
review_scalar_bias_api: review the scalar_bias API that adds a learnable bias vector to enable optional attention in self-attention mechanisms
